About Us

The Team Behind Midlands Roofing and Restorations Ltd

Midlands Roofing and Restorations is run by Nick McAllister, with a team of roofers working from Leamington Spa across Warwickshire and the West Midlands. [PLACEHOLDER Nick's own story: how the business started and how long he has been roofing.]

The work runs from roof repairs and emergency leaks to new roofs in slate and tile, flat roofs, lead work, chimneys, fascias and guttering, and repointing on older stone buildings. Plenty of their customers call them after another roofer has let them down, and the reviews keep coming back to the same things: friendly, tidy and the job done right.

Nick McAllisterOwner, Midlands Roofing and Restorations Ltd
